title: Insulin Pump Program Notice Quantity Schedule for Cartridges and Reservoirs
content:
**Schedule.** A liability notice for the cartridges a coming refill on an Insulin Pump Program ships above the payer's allowance is signed in the tier's notice type against the newest authorization grant for the cartridge item, the grant that refill draws on, for the notice units worked out as follows.

1. **Notice item.** The notice item is the A4232 reservoir for a MiniMed 780G and the A4225 cartridge for every other model.
2. **Standard notice period.** The standard notice period is the tier's supply days per shipment divided by 30, giving the notice's 30-day blocks.
3. **Standard allowance.** The standard allowance is the tier's reservoirs per 30 days.
4. **Standard expected rate.** The standard expected rate is the quantity per 30 days on the written order the newest authorization grant for the item rests on.
5. **Standard computation.** In the standard computation the notice units are the standard expected rate less the standard allowance, never below zero, times the standard notice period's 30-day blocks.
6. **Combination.** Any adjustment to these standard figures changes the standard figure it names, replacements before limits; the notice units are then the expected rate less the allowance, never below zero, times the notice's 30-day blocks.

## Standard computation worked through (hypothetical, 30-day blocks counted at 30 days each)

| Tier supply days | Allowance per 30 days | Expected rate | Notice units |
|---|---|---|---|
| 30 | 10 | 14 | 14 less 10 is 4; times 1 block is 4 |
| 90 | 10 | 15 | 15 less 10 is 5; times 3 blocks is 15 |
| 90 | 15 | 12 | 12 less 15 is below zero, so 0 |
